name: thinklight
description: Camera LED busy-light hooks for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: thinklight
plugins.description: macOS only. Turn the Mac camera LED into an AI busy light: on = the agent is working, off = done, your turn. Opens the camera to light the LED and discards every frame; hooks write a local session token and read no prompt content. Installs its own helper programs into ~/.local/bin from GitHub Releases on the first session, and says so; switchable off. Optional sound, off until you ask for it with /thinklight:unmute; a shared pair of tracks installs as one package with `thinklight theme install`
